findings.issue: CreateFirstAdministrator inserts administrator_initializations.user_id before inserting accounts.user_id, but migration FK is immediate. Valid initialization fails before account creation; use a transaction/lock/reservation design with correct FK ordering and exactly-one concurrent winner.

requireNativeBootstrapDuty selects nonexistent pg_roles.r.olsuper (must rolsuper). CLI verifies NOINHERIT login but repository transaction never SET LOCAL ROLE migration_role; identity schema USAGE granted only API, not migration_role. Ordinary dedicated migration LOGIN cannot execute advertised bootstrap. Align true CLI LOGIN and transactional least-privilege role path, no persistent role or privilege widening.

find_login_account owned schema_owner remains subject to FORCE RLS, uses current_setting app.tenant_id and establishes no trusted tenant context; pre-login without context returns zero rows. record/clear failure have same context issue. Explicitly design restricted pre-auth tenant lookup vs internal context; do not grant BYPASSRLS or remove FORCE RLS. Count/lock writes must target the actual account and preserve newer lock state.

credentials/password_attempts/sessions/role_grants/subject_mappings reference accounts(user_id) only, not (tenant_id,user_id). Tenant-B row can attach to tenant-A account UUID; RLS validates row tenant but cannot enforce relationship. Add account composite uniqueness and tenant-bound FK on every child relation.

Native DB test gate checks only environment flag then delegates to generic SP03_TEST_DATABASE_URL helper; it does not refuse shared host/port/instance. Helper creates roles/databases on arbitrary configured PostgreSQL. Role test LOGIN defaults INHERIT, which masks production NOINHERIT failures. Add dedicated task-owned remote guard before mutations and true NOINHERIT roles, exact CLI exercise and cross-tenant relation rejection tests. No test execution authorized until reviewed.
